newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Capital Intelligence rates three Indian banks.
newsitem.headline: Capital Intelligence rates three Indian banks.

text.p: Bank rating service Capital Intelligence said it assigned initial ratings to three Indian banks.

It assigned ICICI Banking Corp Ltd ratings of BBB long-term and A-2 short-term, with a stable outlook. The high ratings reflect its strong ownership, clean loan portfolio and strong return on assets, although it has limited access to low-cost funds until its branch network expands.

The agency said it rated UTI Bank Ltd as BBB- long-term and A-2 short-term, with a stable outlook for the next 12 months, because of its strong parent, Unit Trust of India, its good management and satisfactory financial position.

It rated Indusind Bank Ltd as BB+ long-term and A-3 short-term, with a stable outlook. The agency said the bank has highly-capable management, a fully-automated branch network and solid overall financial performance. However, its funding cost is higher than industry average and the level of stable funds in its customer deposit base is low.
